---
name: Protocol Contribution
about: Propose a new protocol or protocol enhancement
title: '[PROTOCOL] '
labels: protocol, enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Protocol Name
What should this protocol be called?

## Collaboration Pattern
What real-world collaboration pattern does this model? (e.g., design critique, code review, strategic planning)

## Description
Describe how this protocol works and what makes it unique.

## Participants
- How many agents are involved?
- Are there special roles (facilitator, moderator, etc.)?
- Can humans participate?

## Protocol Flow
Describe the typical flow:
1. Step 1...
2. Step 2...
3. ...

## Expected Outcomes
What kind of results does this protocol produce?

## Collaboration Kit Components
Which primitives from the collab kit would you use?
- [ ] Agenda
- [ ] Chair
- [ ] Roundtable
- [ ] PulseCheck
- [ ] Minutes
- [ ] Other: _____

## Use Cases
Provide 2-3 concrete examples of when you'd use this protocol.

## Prior Art
Are there similar patterns in other frameworks or real-world practices?

## Implementation
Would you like to contribute the implementation?
- [ ] Yes, I can implement this
- [ ] I need help implementing this
- [ ] I'm just proposing the idea
